old_notes_to_compact.note: Placed first settlement on node 12 (Wood 3, Brick 6, Sheep 5). Gemma's node 20 is weak on resources (W11, B6, Desert).
Road placed towards node 11. Aiming for the Wheat port at node 3 or high pip nodes in that area.
Placed second settlement on node 25. Starting resources: Wheat, Sheep, Ore. Jimmy has strong Ore/Wheat production on 42, so I need to prioritize expanding to more Ore or getting a port soon.
Placed road from 25 to 26 to secure the Ore port. My production is Ore-heavy (O3, O4, O5 across both settlements), so this port is critical for my mid-game flexibility.
I am at 2 VP. My current production is solid on Brick (6), Sheep (4,5), Ore (3), and Wheat (8). Need Wood (3) or more Brick to reach the Ore port at Node 26. Gemma is watching me closely.
Moved robber to Hex 18 (Wheat 9). This blocks both Jimmy and Gemma. Stole from Jimmy to slow his city-building potential.
Stole from Jimmy on Hex 18. He had Wheat and Wood; need to see what I get. Gemma is still watching my move to the Ore port.
Node 26 is illegal for a settlement due to proximity to Node 25. Need to plan a longer route to a port or different expansion. Bought a Dev card with 1 Wheat, 1 Sheep, 1 Ore.
